newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia says it is successor to Soviet debt.
newsitem.headline: Russia says it is successor to Soviet debt.

text.p: Russia is already generally regarded as the successor to the debts and assets of the former Soviet Union, and a decision by Ukraine's parliament to delay ratifying a treaty recognising this will not make any difference, a senior Russian central banker said on Wednesday.

The Ukrainian vote is unlikely to have much impact on Russia's rescheduling agreements with the Paris and London clubs of government and commercial bank creditors, First Deputy Central Bank Chairman Sergei Aleksashenko told Reuters.

"Russia is recognised as the legal successor to the debts and assets (of the Soviet Union) all over the world, and all these countries are hardly likely to reconsider their decisions because of the decision of the Ukrainian parliament," he said.
